judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] delivers the most on-topic, mathematically grounded content for Pan–Tompkins (standard band-pass difference equations, five-point derivative, and adaptive threshold update structure), but it is truncated mid-expression and does not reach a full conclusion/length.
